Sizing for 2 concurrent sessions: each user gets 32K of context, llama-server allocates ctx-size = 64K total across the -np 2 slots. KV cache is sized against the total; per-session throughput drops roughly linearly with load.

When a session hits its 32K cap it will SLIDE: oldest tokens drop, generation continues. Set `context-shift = on` and `keep = 256` (tune to your system-prompt length in tokens so instructions survive the shift). To fail hard instead of forgetting old turns, set `context-shift = off` in the form.

TTFT tuning for multi-slot: set `batch-size = 4096` (safe, negligible VRAM). To also improve prompt-eval when a second session arrives mid-generation, bump `ubatch-size` in the form — this is the main lever, but it's costly. On layer-split multi-GPU, compute-buffer VRAM grows as ~8 × ubatch × layers × hidden. A dense 27B (64L, 5120H) at ubatch=2048 costs ~4.7 GB of compute buffers across cards. Don't bump ubatch above 512 unless you have 2+ GB of measured free VRAM after boot. MoE with CPU offload has much more room to work with.

Sizing for 2 concurrent sessions: each user gets 1,000 of context, llama-server allocates ctx-size = 2,000 total across the -np 2 slots. KV cache is sized against the total; per-session throughput drops roughly linearly with load.

When a session hits its 1,000 cap it will SLIDE: oldest tokens drop, generation continues. Set `context-shift = on` and `keep = 256` (tune to your system-prompt length in tokens so instructions survive the shift). To fail hard instead of forgetting old turns, set `context-shift = off` in the form.

TTFT tuning for multi-slot: set `batch-size = 4096` (safe, negligible VRAM). On layer-split multi-GPU, compute-buffer VRAM grows as ~8 × ubatch × layers × hidden. A dense 27B (64L, 5120H) at ubatch=2048 costs ~4.7 GB of compute buffers across cards. Don't bump ubatch above 512 unless you have 2+ GB of measured free VRAM after boot. MoE with CPU offload has much more room to work with.
